security_audit.summary: All 34 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown, template text, normal ZIP creation, or validator control flow. Separate review found unsafe path containment in initialization and unsafe symlink handling during packaging. Publication should wait until these file-handling weaknesses are fixed.

remediation.issue: An unvalidated skill name can escape the selected output directory.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce the documented hyphen-case rule, reject path separators, and verify the resolved destination remains inside the selected base directory.

remediation.issue: Packaging can include data from symlink targets outside the skill directory.
remediation.suggestion: Reject symlinks and verify every resolved file remains inside the resolved skill directory before adding it to the archive.

semantic_findings.title: Skill Name Can Escape the Output Directory
semantic_findings.description: The initializer appends an unvalidated skill name to the selected base path. Absolute names or parent segments can create files outside that base.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script documents naming restrictions but does not enforce them or verify destination containment before creating files.

semantic_findings.title: Archive Packaging Follows External Symlink Targets
semantic_findings.description: The packager follows file symlinks and writes their target contents into the archive. A crafted skill can include files outside its directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Path.is_file() and ZipFile.write() follow symlinks, while the loop performs no resolved-path boundary check.

content.value_statement: AI skill projects often need consistent structure, clear triggering rules, and reusable resources. This skill guides creation, validates basic metadata, and packages finished projects.
actual_capabilities: Guides discovery of concrete user requests and trigger conditions before implementation.
Explains how to divide instructions among SKILL.md, scripts, references, and assets.
Creates a starter skill directory with templates and example resources.
Checks basic frontmatter, required fields, naming rules, and description characters.
Packages a validated skill directory as a distributable ZIP archive.
limitations: Generated templates contain placeholders and example files that require manual editing or removal.
Validation uses regular expressions and does not fully parse YAML or inspect resource safety.
Packaging includes every regular file and does not prevent symlink targets outside the skill directory.
The tools operate on local files and do not publish skills to a marketplace.

use_cases.title: Create a First Skill
use_cases.description: Turn a defined AI workflow into a structured skill with focused instructions and only the resources it needs.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Skills
use_cases.description: Apply a shared structure for triggers, workflows, scripts, references, and assets across internal skill projects.

use_cases.title: Validate and Package Releases
use_cases.description: Check basic metadata and create a ZIP archive for a reviewed skill directory.

prompt_templates.title: Create a New Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill named [name] in [directory] for [goal]. Ask for essential examples, then initialize the structure.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a first skill from a clear goal.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a skill for [workflow]. Identify concrete requests, then decide which scripts, references, and assets should be included.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose resources before writing detailed instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the skill at [path]. Improve trigger metadata, instruction structure, progressive disclosure, and resource references without adding unnecessary files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Refine an existing skill for clarity and efficiency.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Skill Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the skill at [path] for placeholders, unnecessary files, path safety, and metadata quality. Apply focused fixes, validate it, then package it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Complete an advanced review before distribution.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing vendor invoices.
output: A vendor-invoice-review skill directory is created.
The main instructions define trigger conditions and a review workflow.
Only required policy references and validation resources are retained.

output_examples.input: Improve this large skill that repeats API documentation.
output_examples.output: The core workflow remains in SKILL.md, while detailed API material moves to a referenced document. Duplicate guidance and unused examples are removed.

output_examples.input: Validate and package the reviewed release.
output_examples.output: Basic metadata and naming checks pass. The reviewed directory is packaged as a distributable ZIP archive in the selected output location.

best_practices: Begin with concrete user requests and define clear trigger conditions.
Keep core instructions concise and place detailed material in referenced resources.
Remove placeholders, inspect bundled files, and validate the skill before packaging.
anti_patterns: Do not keep TODO placeholders or unused example resources in a release.
Do not duplicate the same detailed guidance across SKILL.md and reference files.
Do not package unreviewed directories that may contain symlinks or sensitive files.

faq.question: Can this skill create and update skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides workflows for new projects and focused improvements to existing skill directories.

faq.question: What file is required in every skill?
faq.answer: Every skill requires a SKILL.md file with valid frontmatter and useful instructions.

faq.question: Does the validator fully parse YAML?
faq.answer: No. It performs basic text and naming checks with regular expressions.

faq.question: Which resource types can a skill include?
faq.answer: A skill can include scripts for automation, references for detailed knowledge, and assets for output materials.

faq.question: Does packaging publish the skill?
faq.answer: No. Packaging creates a local ZIP archive and does not upload it to any marketplace.

faq.question: Can I use the workflow with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The structure and creation workflow apply to all three supported tools.
